name: gen-fal
description: 3D generators from fal.ai behind one key: Pixal3D, TRELLIS.2, Rodin 2.5, Meshy-6, Hunyuan 3.1 (image-to-3D, part splitter, smart topology) and Tripo P2, with live option schemas, prices and a quote before every job

setup.title: Create a fal API key
setup.detail: Create a key in the fal dashboard. It stays on this machine and is sent only to fal (queue.fal.run, api.fal.ai, rest.fal.ai). An API-scope key covers generation, the model catalogue and prices; a job's actual cost is read from fal's billing events, which need an admin-scope key, and without one the job is recorded at its quote.

setup.title: Fund the account
setup.detail: fal is prepaid: every job draws down credits. Each job's price is quoted before it is submitted and checked against Dimension's spend caps, so a job over the cap never starts.

setup.title: Know what leaves this machine
setup.detail: Reference images and 3D files a job uses are uploaded to fal's CDN, which serves them by public URL, and are asked to expire after 24 hours. Rodin, Meshy, Hunyuan and Tripo are partner models: fal passes your prompt, options and files on to those vendors. Hunyuan and Pixal3D outputs are marked prototype-only until their licences are reviewed.

form.label: fal API key
form.help: Used for every fal generation job. Create it at fal.ai/dashboard/keys.
